class: A phase review's primary reviewer stops on an exhausted credit balance before any model item, and a fallback authorised only for another role and mode (a learning digest) is about to take the review packet.
notes: Step 1 (registered): the primary review attempt (fallback-primary-usage.json, rollout-*.jsonl: credits depleted, zero model items) is an attempt record, not an empty review; its hold waits on a balance probe or an operator top-up, never a time. Step 2 (fallback_scope, proposed; named as a placement check in note 05): the placement path refuses the learning-route fallback for mode phase_review before egress, so the packet never leaves and no fallback usage (usage.json) is ever recorded or allowed to replace the primary's record; an authorised fallback of another family would re-check independence first.
